name: Leydig cell
short_description: Hormone factory of the testis: makes testosterone on orders from the pituitary. Drives sperm production and male traits.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; rounded polygonal cell, large pale eccentric nucleus with 2 nucleoli, dense smooth-ER tubule network dominating cytoplasm, tubulovesicular-cristae mitochondria, lipid droplets, Golgi, Reinke crystal rod, lipofuscin granules, small capillary/RBC context in the interstitium — matches the science reference; used as SVG base after fixing label-collision layout)
textbook.2: fail (gemini-2.5-flash-image; odd amoeboid outline with a notch/tail-like protrusion, less faithful to the polygonal/rounded Leydig-cell morphology than attempt 1; not used)

sem.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; rounded/polygonal cell surface with subtle micro-folds, sitting in a fibrous interstitial substrate beside a smooth-walled capillary, false-colour peach/tan cell vs dusty-rose connective tissue vs blue-grey vessel, surface-only as expected for SEM, no internal organelles, no text/border)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; natural-tint cutaway — pale eccentric nucleus with 2 nucleoli, dense lavender SER tangle, terracotta mitochondria with tubular cristae, lipid droplets, violet Golgi cluster, pink Reinke-crystal rod, lipofuscin granules, small capillary/RBC context bud outside the cell; label layout re-annotated so the plasma-membrane leader no longer crosses into the nucleus)

watercolor.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; full-bleed aged paper, octagonal/rounded cell with the same organelle set as the other styles rendered as ink-and-wash, single specimen; label layout re-annotated to fix a text collision and a mitochondria leader line that originally terminated inside the nucleus)
